conclusion: Credible aggregate evidence exists for MCU multiplicity and clustering, but no public raw trace with a verified logical-to-physical mapping was found that can defensibly instantiate SafeForge's finite word-level PMF. Synthetic bit-exact benchmarks therefore remain the executable evidence, explicitly supplemented—not replaced—by literature aggregate constraints.
